mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lymph drainage network to the body was most worthwhile because it tied fluid collection and return to the blood supply, rather than leaving them as separate parts.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate collecting-vessel and vein connections felt a little repetitive once the pictures had already shown where the duct needed to go.

surprise.text: I hadn't expected fluid and proteins from between cells to return to the blood through a separate lymph route. The flap openings made the first part understandable.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary: the pictures showed the connections, although the lymph route was mostly a straightforward sequence rather than a difficult choice.

continue.text: I would probably try another chapter if it connected systems in a new way. Seeing why fluid needs a return route was interesting, though I would hope for more meaningful choices than this mostly linear sequence.
